name: Vendooly
description:
Vendooly is the action layer for Amazon: it connects your Seller Central (SP-API) and Amazon Ads data to Claude and makes them queryable in natural language.

What you can do:
• Sales & revenue: orders, revenue, sales velocity, diagnose drops.
• Catalog & listings: products, listing issues and suppressed listings, catalog quality.
• Pricing: your prices and competitors', Buy Box, repricing.
• Inventory & FBA: stock, coverage, inbound shipments and discrepancies.
• Amazon Ads (Sponsored Products): campaigns, ad groups, keywords, performance reports.

Read and write, with a safety brake: before any change to prices, stock, budgets or campaigns, Vendooly shows exactly what is about to change (SKU/ASIN, before→after values, rows affected) and waits for your explicit confirmation. No surprise actions.

Privacy: each seller authorizes their own Amazon account via the official OAuth flow. Vendooly does not expose buyer personal data (no names, addresses or contact details). Data may come from periodically refreshed snapshots rather than real time; AI outputs are decision support and should be verified before acting.

Built on the official Amazon SP-API and Amazon Ads APIs. By Vendooly S.r.l.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vendooly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vendooly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.vendooly.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Vendooly MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vendooly lists 77 MCP tools, including ads_create_sp_ad_group, ads_create_sp_campaign, ads_create_sp_keywords, ads_create_sp_negative_keywords, ads_create_sp_product_ads, ads_delete_sp_negative_keywords, ads_get_sp_report, ads_list_profiles, ads_list_sp_ad_groups, ads_list_sp_campaigns, ads_list_sp_keywords, and ads_list_sp_negative_keywords.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vendooly?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Vendooly in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Vendooly requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Vendooly is developed by Vendooly S.r.l.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
